svg.aria-label: Level sets of three quadratic forms. Left: x1 squared plus x2 squared is positive definite, with closed elliptic level curves round a single minimum. Middle: (x1 + x2) squared is only positive semidefinite: it is zero along the whole line x1 = −x2. Right: 2x1 squared + 6x1x2 + 2x2 squared is indefinite, with eigenvalues 5 and −1: positive along x1 = x2, negative along x1 = −x2
